latest_release.focus: global reconciliation sequence continuity, per-key dispatch-generation monotonicity, stale not-executed evidence reuse rejection, explicit read snapshot, and restore/reopen audit-history preservation

focus: global reconciliation sequence continuity, per-key dispatch-generation monotonicity, stale not-executed evidence reuse rejection, explicit read snapshot, and restore/reopen audit-history preservation
safety_boundary: Backup validation checks local SQLite integrity, schema version, required columns and indexes, ledger decoding, audit schema types/constraints, contiguous audit sequence, per-key generation monotonicity, stale evidence reuse, timestamps, and cross-record references; it does not prove authenticity or off-host durability.

The v58 tests exercise missing global sequence entries, histories that begin after sequence one, dispatch-generation regressions, stale not-executed evidence reuse, valid multi-generation histories, read-only refusal, concurrent validation, and restore/reopen preservation.
An explicit SQLite read transaction keeps validation queries on one read snapshot; local tests do not establish distributed exactly-once execution or disaster-recovery RPO/RTO.
Real-money payment processing remains NO-GO until the provider sandbox is independently verified.
